channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Weight-loss drugs may boost job prospects for women, study finds
item.description: A Harvard economist's research suggests GLP-1 drugs significantly improved unemployed women's chances of securing employment.

item.title: American missionary Kevin Rideout freed after nine months held in Niger
item.description: Kevin Rideout, an American missionary abducted in Niger last October, has been released and will reunite with his extended family.

item.title: Luigi Mangione expected to plead guilty in killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO
item.description: Luigi Mangione is anticipated to enter a guilty plea on Friday in the federal case related to the killing of the former UnitedHealthcare CEO in Manhattan.

item.title: Double jeopardy implications after Mangione's guilty plea
item.description: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty to two federal counts on Friday. His state trial is scheduled to begin on Sept. 8.
